title: Syed Refaat Ahmed
content:
{{Short description|Bangladeshi judge}}
'''Syed Refat Ahmed''' is a justice of the Bangladesh Supreme Court and former judge of the Bangladesh High Court.

==Early life==
Ahmed studied law at the [[Wadham College]] of Oxford University in 1983.<ref>{{cite web |title=Mr Justice Syed Refaat Ahmed |url=https://www.wadham.ox.ac.uk/people/alumni/a/syed-refaat-ahmed |website=wadham.ox.ac.uk |accessdate=7 January 2020}}</ref> He studied International Relations at [[The Fletcher School of Law and Diplomacy]] of [[Tufts University]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Syed Refaat Ahmed |url=http://www.uplbooks.com/author/syed-refaat-ahmed |website=uplbooks.com |publisher=The University Press Limited |accessdate=7 January 2020}}</ref> His father, Barrister [[Syed Ishtiaq Ahmed]], was a former attorney general of Bangladesh.<ref>{{cite news |title=Barrister Syed Ishtiaq Ahmed Memorial Lecture 2019 |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/law-our-rights/news/barrister-syed-ishtiaq-ahmed-memorial-lecture-2019-1847611 |accessdate=7 January 2020 |work=The Daily Star |date=31 December 2019 |language=en}}</ref> His mother, Dr. Sufia Ahmed, was a National Professor of Islamic Studies at Dhaka University.

==Career==
Ahmed is a justice of the Bangladesh High Court.<ref>{{cite news |title=‘Cops, judges must together ensure justice’ |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/city/news/police-judges-must-together-ensure-justice-says-syed-refaat-ahmed-1637578 |accessdate=7 January 2020 |work=The Daily Star |date=23 September 2018 |language=en}}</ref> In 2018, he was part of a divided bench on the question of Khaleda Zia participating in the general election. He had asked the Election Commission to accept the nomination of former Prime Minister [[Khaleda Zia]] while his fellow judge on the bench, Justice [[Iqbal Kabir]], disagreed and blocked the participation of Khaleda Zia.<ref>{{cite news |title=Top judge sends Khaleda file back to High Court panel for clarification |url=https://bdnews24.com/politics/2018/12/12/top-judge-sends-khaleda-file-back-to-high-court-panel-for-clarification |accessdate=7 January 2020 |work=bdnews24.com}}</ref> On 28 July 2019, High Court bench led by him banned the marketing of pasteurized milk by 14 companies.<ref>{{cite news |title=Justice Syed Refaat Ahmed-led bench’s jurisdiction changed |url=http://www.newagebd.net/article/81482/justice-syed-refaat-ahmed-led-benchs-jurisdiction-changed |accessdate=7 January 2020 |work=New Age |language=en}}</ref> He was promoted to the Supreme Court of Bangladesh in 2019.<ref>{{cite news |title=Role of Baljit Singh Tyagi and BSF in our Liberation War |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/opinion/news/role-baljit-singh-tyagi-and-bsf-our-liberation-war-1841140 |accessdate=7 January 2020 |work=The Daily Star |date=17 December 2019 |language=en}}</ref>
